printer: Prusa CORE One, 0.6 mm nozzle, Buddy camera via go2rtc (1920x1080), smooth PEI sheet
derived_from: bubbler-guard-and-pad-pla-healthy, a clean black PLA print of the bubbler guard and pad: its slice with a planted colour change, and its own frames, some recoloured
part: the bubbler guard, a round cylinder to Z 142, and the saddle pad, an arched strip to Z 11.4, in black PLA
verdict: healthy: the print carried on in the colour its G-code plans

fault.kind: a colour change the G-code plans
fault.how: fault.diff plants PrusaSlicer 2.9.6's colour change to #FF0000 (`;COLOR_CHANGE,T0,#FF0000`, `M600`, and its prime) after the `;AFTER_LAYER_CHANGE` block of layer Z 50, so the red starts on that layer, and names the filament black (`; filament_colour = #000000`) where its profile left the slicer's default orange; nothing else changes

what_it_looks_like: the guard's walls are black up to Z 50 and red from Z 50 to the rim at Z 58.8, exactly where the slice changes colour

expected_agent_action.after_the_change: carry on; the new colour is the one planned, from the layer planned

frames.label: Z 1.0 early layers, in the black filament: the guard's C-shaped base wall on its brim with a comb of build-plate support in the saddle opening, and the pad starting at back right; all clean and stuck. A byte-for-byte copy of ../bubbler-guard-and-pad-pla-healthy/agent-005-obs-165325-p01.7.jpg.

Z 58.8: the guard's perimeter walls, black throughout, with the square-edged start of its designed side slot at the front-right of the rim. A byte-for-byte copy of ../bubbler-guard-and-pad-pla-healthy/agent-048-obs-180412-p65.7.jpg, and the frame the recoloured one stands in for.

derived, not a camera frame: recoloured afterwards from frame-180412-p65.7.jpg, every outer wall laid from Z 50 to the frame's Z 58.8 made #FF0000, as the change planned at Z 50 leaves them, and the toolhead over the rim left as it was; healthy, in the planned colour

sources.gcode: the printed G-code is ../bubbler-guard-and-pad-pla-healthy/bubbler_guard_and_pad.gcode with fault.diff applied: the diff is committed alone, because the printed file differs from that slice by nothing else, and the replay makes it from the slice
sources.frames: frame-165325-p01.7.jpg and frame-180412-p65.7.jpg are ../bubbler-guard-and-pad-pla-healthy/agent-005-obs-165325-p01.7.jpg and ../bubbler-guard-and-pad-pla-healthy/agent-048-obs-180412-p65.7.jpg; recolour-frame-180412-p65.7.jpg is frame-180412-p65.7.jpg recoloured by tools/camera-calibration's camera_calibration.recolour, whose test there reproduces it byte for byte

scenarios.summary: A periodic observation of the healthy black first layers at 1.7%, long before any colour change; the agent should carry on and change nothing.

The server's check as the print carries on from the colour change its G-code plans at Z 50 shows the walls red from there up, which is the expected colour; the agent should carry on and change nothing.
